KEY        ID     PERMS OWNER USEDBYTES MSGS LSPID LRPID
The KEY column is the key the queue was created with, in hexadecimal,
and ID is the identifier msgget returned. PERMS and OWNER are the
mode and the owning user. USEDBYTES is the bytes held by queued
messages, rounded to a unit unless --bytes is given, and MSGS counts
them. LSPID and LRPID are the last processes to send and to receive.
